resources.string: Create paper bodies. Repeated reporters become cursed.
Create paper bodies. Players who report enough are cursed to die at the next meeting. Killing you lifts their curse.

Create normal-looking corpses with tiny unpainted edges. Each reporter accumulates reports separately for each Papetir. Reaching the configured threshold warns that player; the curse kills them at the following meeting, unless Papetir dies first. Win by claiming the required number of distinct victims. Unreported paper bodies disappear when a meeting starts. Zero body limit means unlimited.
Each body you report adds a speed bonus for the rest of the match.

Shield players and earn your reveal
Shield players and mark living Crewmates to unlock Reveal. Revealing too early disables marking for one round.

Shield players and mark living Crewmates to unlock a meeting reveal. The qualifying last mark grants no shield; shields end when you die. An early reveal blocks marking for a round. Revealing stops marking and grants configured protection. Voting may still eject you; protection ends below three living players.
Borrow a role after the meeting
Choose a target. Borrow their role after the next meeting, then return it after the following meeting. You stay Crew.

Choose a living target. After the next meeting, borrow their role for one round while they become a Crewmate. After the following meeting, both roles return. You always win with Crew.

Gather bodies to identify a killer
Gather up to three bodies and pray. Next meeting, learn the killer's role and two living suspects: the killer and a random player.
Gather up to three bodies and pray. Next meeting, learn the killer's role and two living suspects: the killer and a random player.

Gather three bodies, or all available if fewer. Prayer privately reveals the killer's role and two living suspects next meeting, in random order. One is the real killer; the other is a random player other than you. If the killer dies or no second suspect remains, no suspects are revealed.
Exorcism complete. You will learn the truth at the next meeting.
Prayer revealed: <first> or <second>. One of them is the killer, whose role is <role>.

Use your tablet to force a player to kill before time runs out, or die. Watch through their eyes while your body stays still.
Force a player to kill or die. You watch them while immobile. Their successful kill counts as yours. Win with Impostors.

Pick a living player on your tablet, anywhere on the map. They choose their victim and gain one normal-range Kill with a red countdown. A successful kill counts as yours; shields do not complete the task. Otherwise they die when time expires. You cannot move or use abilities while watching them. Your camera returns three seconds after their kill or death. Meetings cancel by default; when disabled, they pause the effect. You have no ordinary Kill and no use limit.
Bury bodies to win, or inherit a buried role at a meeting.
Follow body arrows. Bury bodies to win alone, or permanently inherit a buried role during a meeting.
Bury bodies to win alone. At a meeting, you may instead take one buried role and its victory condition. You can inherit only once.

Follow arrows to corpses and use Bury nearby. Each victim counts once. Reach Bodies Required to Win to end the game with your own victory. Before that, use Inherit Role during a meeting to choose a buried role. The change is permanent: you lose Bury and body arrows, gain the new role and its victory condition, and cannot inherit again or return to Gravedigger. The new role's normal transformations still work.
